nodes.question: How many females were sampled from high-altitude and low-altitude populations?
nodes.answer: A total of 48 females were sampled from high-altitude populations and 34 from low-altitude populations.

nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What was one of the primary focuses of the survey conducted on HIA research?
nodes.answer: The survey focused on understanding participants' current roles, backgrounds in HIA, their views on important areas of research, priority research questions, and ways to build and support HIA research.
